name: io.github.ahamadfalah/mintsoft-mcp
description: Mintsoft WMS API as MCP tools — orders, products, stock, inbound, returns, reports. Read-only by default; writes gated behind an explicit client allowlist; every call audit-logged.

environmentVariables.name: MINTSOFT_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the 8 write tools (default 0 = read-only)

environmentVariables.name: MINTSOFT_WRITE_CLIENT_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ClientIds writes may touch. Empty (default) = all writes refused. Mintsoft has no sandbox — allowlist only a dedicated test client.
